Senses.PreferredTarget: a young girl with forked hair-knots, her hair white as silk
SearchAliases: a young girl with forked hair-knots, her hair white as silk
Senses.Note: 丫角 indicates a girl's forked or horn-like hair arrangement, not literal horns. Preserve the whole young-and-old image rather than resolving its contradiction. No lamp is retained.

Occurrences.Kwic: ，遠山無限碧層層。僧問投子和尚住此山有何境界子云丫角女子白頭絲僧問投子：和尚住此山有何境界？子云：丫角女子白頭
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1396.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wujian Xiandu. Touzi Datong owns the retained deployment: case commentary and verse.

Occurrences.Kwic: 人來相問山何境，徹底從頭舉似伊，急著眼，莫遲疑，丫角女子白頭絲。咦。投子指菴前石投子布山漫天網，雪峰走入伊圈套
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J10/J10nA158.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Miyun. Touzi Datong's answer words are retained verbatim in Miyun Yuanwu's verse within Miyun's own record.

Occurrences.Kwic: 示眾示眾丫角女子白頭絲。報儞諸方作者知。借問住山何境界。春風𩖼𩖼春鳥喧喧。翠峯不能助發。心印却是他傳。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1996.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Mingjue, whose own stupa inscription inside the work gives the master's taboo name as Chongxian. Xuedou Chongxian owns the admonition deployment: addressing the assembly he opens with the horned-bun maiden's white-headed silk, tells the makers of all quarters they are hereby informed, lends the question of what realm a mountain-dwelling has, and closes that the spring wind and spring birds cannot help it forth — the mind-seal alone was transmitted by him.

Occurrences.Kwic: 投子因僧問：和尚住此山有何境界？師曰：丫角女子白頭絲。丫角女子白頭絲，猛燄堆中雪片飛，一等住山誰可擬？閒雲流水不同歸。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1351.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baiyun Shouduan, his own verse on the raised case. Baiyun Shouduan owns the versifying deployment: after the case of the monk asking Touzi what realm his mountain has and Touzi answering with the horned-bun maiden's white-headed silk, Baiyun's own verse takes the line as its opening — snowflakes flying in a raging blaze of flame — asks what ordinary mountain-dweller could match it, and grants that idle clouds and flowing waters do not return together.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂云。窮萬化之淵源。得一真之住處。體空而了了。不涉根門。照盡而綿綿。全超塵想。直得光境俱斷。心法兩忘。卓爾獨存。廓然圓湛。生滅去來。不我遷變。便能應緣無礙。靜照亡功。所以僧問投子。如何是和尚安樂處。子云。丫角女子白頭絲。師云。諸禪德。當明有暗。當暗有明。鬧浩浩中靜悄悄。靜悄悄中明歷歷。還委悉麼。良久云。行到水窮處。坐看雲起時。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T48/T48n2001.xml). Extensive Record of Chan Master Hongzhi. Hongzhi Zhengjue owns the commenting deployment: in hall he traces the source of the myriad transformations to the dwelling place of the one truth — essence empty yet lucid, freed from the sense-gates, shining spent yet continuous, wholly past the dust-thoughts — then raises that a monk asked Touzi what his place of ease was and Touzi answered with the maiden line, and comments to the worthies of Chan: within light there is dark, within dark there is light, quiet within the noisy clamor, distinct within the quiet, sealing it after a long silence with walking to where the water ends and sitting to watch the clouds rise.

Senses.Explanation: Touzi Datong answers the mountain-scenery question with a girl's forked hair-knots and white hair joined in one impossible image. Touzi Datong uses the expression through case commentary and verse. Touzi Datong's answer words are retained verbatim in Miyun Yuanwu's verse of his own record.
